highlight_subsections.summary: vLLM's V1 engine is ready for testing! This is a rewritten engine designed for performance and architectural simplicity. You can turn it on by setting environment variable `VLLM_USE_V1=1`. See [our blog](https://blog.vllm.ai/2025/01/27/v1-alpha-release.html) for more details. (44 commits).
